meta.title: End before start is refused
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the event create screen to reach the schedule drawer.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Apply a pricing template so scheduling is available.
Add the required line item for the schedule controls to become usable.
Complete the pricing sheet before opening the schedule drawer.
Open the schedule drawer, matching the test setup.
Set a valid future start time for the baseline schedule.
Set a valid baseline end time after the start.
Record the start value that must remain after the refused save.
Record the valid end value that must remain after the refused save.
Set the end time earlier than the start to exercise the validation.
Attempt to save the invalid schedule.
Assert that Procol reports a readable refusal.
Close the still-open schedule drawer after the refused save.
Reopen the schedule drawer to inspect whether the invalid values were persisted.
Verify the original start value is still shown.
Verify the original valid end value is still shown.
